issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台按 md 抓成 66f，改版前视频停在 "DECODE S6604"，最后 5 个字符没锁完
亮灰平底配灰字，看不出技术产品要的终端/解码气质；字体回退 ui-monospace，乱码和真字只差颜色
所有乱码字亮度一样，看不出解码头在哪、正往哪推进
锁定反色闪是一块直角黑块，锁定后没有任何落定动作；进度条是 10px 灰块按字数一格一格跳
changes: 导出 SCRAMBLE_DECODE_DURATION = 130（帧 86 锁完最后一个字符，静止 44f）
改成带色相的暗场（Backdrop dark + 靛蓝余光 + 暗角 + 颗粒），锁定字近白 #eef0f6、乱码用低透明冷灰，0–10f 乱码自左向右渐显
乱码亮度按到解码头的距离分级（0.3→0.75），解码头下有强调色短下划线，每次锁定后 4f snappy 跳到下一个真字符（跳过空格）
保留帧 20+i×6 锁定和 2f 反色闪，闪块改成浅色圆角块带柔光；锁定后字形 6f 从 1.14 收回 1，叠 14f 衰减的强调色底光
底部 HUD：3px 细轨 + 平滑推进的渐变填充 + 32px 等宽状态（DECODING→DECODED）与 tabular-nums 计数
issuesEn: No exported duration constant: the workbench took 66f from the md, so the before video stops at "DECODE S6604" with the last five characters still unlocked
Gray text on a flat light-gray ground has none of the terminal, code-breaking feel a tech product needs; the font fell back to ui-monospace, and scrambled and real glyphs differed only in color
Every scrambled glyph had the same brightness, so there was no visible decode head or direction of progress
The lock flash was a square black block with no settle afterward, and the 10px gray progress bar jumped one character at a time
changesEn: Exported SCRAMBLE_DECODE_DURATION = 130 (last character locks at frame 86, then 44f of stillness)

Moved to a hue-tinted dark scene (dark Backdrop, faint indigo glow, vignette, grain); locked glyphs are near-white #eef0f6, scrambled glyphs a low-opacity cool gray, and the scramble fades in from left to right over frames 0–10

Scramble brightness now rises with proximity to the decode head (0.3→0.75); an accent underline marks the head and makes a 4f snappy jump to the next real character after each lock, skipping the space

Kept the 20+i×6 lock timing and the 2f inverse flash, now drawn as a light rounded cell with a soft glow; each locked glyph settles from 1.14 to 1 over 6f under an accent underglow that fades over 14f
Bottom HUD: a 3px track with a smoothly advancing gradient fill, a 32px monospace status (DECODING→DECODED) and a tabular-nums counter
